written: 2026-09-28, after the owner decided (same day) to move flagship A's cell model from SPM to DFN, enable the heat of mixing and re-identify the electrode balance with wider bounds; after the Chen 2020 paper was read (docs/flagships/big14/chen2020_independence.json); before any run of this study
owner_decision: flagship A switches to PyBaMM DFN with the heat of mixing enabled, whatever this study's outcome; this study measures what that model does against the LG M50 curves and decides only whether the identified balance correction is carried into the flagship
does_not_change: big14-a-lgm50-validation and big14-a-lgm50-electrode-balance stay NOT MET as registered

classification.C/2, 1C, 1.5C: consistency with the data Chen2020 was tuned on (in-sample for five Chen2020 parameters); NOT validation. A MET here is an optimistic, in-sample statement; the out-of-sample model-form error stays UNKNOWN
classification.C/10: outside Chen2020's tuning; cell02 C/10 is this study's calibration curve, cell03 and cell04 C/10 check only that the calibration transfers between sibling cells

data: the same pinned files as big14-a-lgm50-validation (benchmarks/measurements/chen2020_lgm50/manifest.json), loaded and sha256-verified by the same loader

model.primary: PyBaMM DFN, Chen2020 as shipped with PyBaMM 26.8.0.0, options {thermal: lumped, heat of mixing: true}
model.secondary_reported_not_judged: PyBaMM SPM with the same options, the same identified factors and the same heat-transfer coefficient (not re-identified for SPM)
model.not_done: no per-rate negative diffusivity (the paper's own per-rate values would be fitted to the test curves); no other Chen2020 parameter is changed

parameters: Negative electrode active material volume fraction (Chen2020: 0.75) as a multiplicative factor in [0.70, 1.20]
Positive electrode active material volume fraction (Chen2020: 0.665) as a multiplicative factor in [0.70, 1.20]
step_1_balance.objective: the same as big14-a-lgm50-electrode-balance: hypot(voltage RMSE in mV, 1000 x relative capacity error)
step_1_balance.optimizer: Nelder-Mead from (1, 1), factors clipped to the bounds, xatol 1e-4, fatol 0.01, maxiter 400, DFN
step_1_balance.heat_transfer_coefficient_during_step_1: 3.555 W/m2K (the value identified in big14-a-lgm50-validation); declared, not iterated
step_1_balance.at_bound: a factor within 1e-3 of either bound is reported AT BOUND

step_2_heat_transfer.curve: cell02 at 1C, surface temperature RMSE, bounded scalar minimisation (xatol 0.05), with the step-1 factors
step_2_heat_transfer.no_iteration: step 1 is not repeated with the step-2 value

held_out: every curve except cell02 C/10 (voltage and capacity) and cell02 1C (temperature)
metrics: identical to big14-a-lgm50-validation (window to the earlier 2.5 V end on the measured 30 s samples)

acceptance_primary.scope: DFN primary, C/2, each of the three cells
acceptance_primary.T1: |peak-rise error| <= max(1.5 K, 25 % of the measured rise)
acceptance_primary.met_if: V1, C1 and T1 on all three cells

decision_rule_for_the_flagship.balance: if neither factor is AT BOUND, flagship A carries both factors as a declared, identified (not measured) correction; if either is AT BOUND the identification has failed and flagship A keeps Chen2020's balance
decision_rule_for_the_flagship.heat_transfer: the identified coefficient belongs to the test rig and is NOT carried into flagship A, whose cell-to-coolant path is its own declared resistance
decision_rule_for_the_flagship.reported_band: flagship A reports the measured DFN C/2 voltage RMSE range and peak-rise error range as a model-form band measured against in-sample data, labelled as likely optimistic

reported_not_judged: all rates and cells for DFN and SPM: every metric
the identified factors, AT BOUND flags, step-1 objective, identified h and its fit residual
the heat-of-mixing share of the total heat at each rate for cell02
stated_limits: Chen2020 has an Arrhenius term only on the exchange currents; the 1C and 1.5C curves reach about 55-58 degC, so a high-rate capacity shortfall is expected from missing temperature dependence of diffusion and is not attributed to the balance
the reversible (entropic) heat stays absent: Chen2020 carries no entropic data
lumped cell temperature against a surface thermocouple
instrument accuracy is not stated in the dataset and stays UNKNOWN
no_change_after_seeing_results: model, options, bounds, curves, objective, criteria and the decision rule are fixed
